title: Fig and the Seed
checkpoint: Reception Spring 2, week 3 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds ow, oi, ear
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 3 complete, 50-sound stage (air, ure, er just added). A true fact: a seed really does grow root first, then a shoot, over several days of watching and waiting.

pages.text: Fig sees a seed in the tub.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar peering into a round wooden tub, spotting a small brown seed inside.
Close view of the small brown seed resting in dark soil inside the tub.
Fig the caterpillar sitting beside the wooden tub, waiting patiently.
A thin white root just visible pushing up through the dark soil in the tub.

pages.text: Fig waits. A shoot pops up.
pages.illustration: A small green shoot poking up out of the soil in the tub.

pages.text: Fig waits. The shoot gets big.
pages.illustration: The green shoot grown taller, with Fig beside the tub for size comparison.
A small round bud sitting on top of the tall green shoot.

pages.text: Fig sits near the tub. The shoot is big.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar sitting beside the wooden tub next to the tall green shoot.
